fields.headline: How the world's fastest-growing startup stays fast with Notion
fields.subhead: Cursor became the fastest-growing company in history by giving developers a truly AI-native code editor. Notion is where that fast-moving team keeps its knowledge, decisions, and plans.
fields.mediaAlt: Cursor product surface embedded in a Notion doc

fields.jcr:title: Cursor: the fastest-growing company in history

fields.text:
Cursor became the fastest-growing company in history by giving developers a truly AI-native code editor. In just a few years the team scaled from a handful of engineers to more than a hundred people across product, research, design, and go-to-market -- all shipping every week.

They chose Notion as the connective tissue for that speed: a single workspace where research, planning, product specs, customer feedback, engineering docs, and company knowledge live side by side.

fields.jcr:title: Why they build instead of buy

fields.text:
While Cursor's rapid growth has demanded ever-more sophisticated internal systems, the team resists tool sprawl. Instead of stitching together a dozen point tools, they built their internal stack on Notion -- from product briefs and design reviews to hiring pipelines and go-to-market plans.

When a workflow gets heavy, they turn it into a Notion database with the exact views their team needs. Everything stays in the same workspace, searchable and cross-linked.

fields.quoteText: I honestly can't imagine running a design team without Notion. Everything we ship -- from moodboards to specs to launch plans -- lives in one place, and that keeps us fast.

fields.jcr:title: AI is strongest where work flows and knowledge grows

fields.text:
Fast-moving teams generate an enormous amount of context -- customer calls, design critiques, engineering debates, launch retros. Notion AI, built into the workspace where Cursor teams work and collaborate, turns that context into leverage: instant answers, drafted summaries, translated notes, and generated to-dos, all grounded in the team's own docs.

Because everything lives in Notion, Notion AI has the shared memory a fast startup needs.

fields.altText: Notion AI answering questions grounded in Cursor's docs
fields.caption: Notion AI, embedded in the docs Cursor writes every day.

fields.quoteText: Keeping people in the loop as we've grown so fast is really hard. Notion is the way we do it -- every project, every decision, every retro is one link away.

fields.jcr:title: The modern stack: 5x fewer tools required

fields.text: Where most companies at this scale run more than a dozen SaaS tools -- separate wikis, doc editors, project trackers, spec repos, briefs, roadmaps -- Cursor runs on Notion for nearly all of it. Their teams estimate they use 5x fewer tools than a comparable startup, which means fewer context switches, fewer integrations to maintain, and faster onboarding for every new hire.

fields.quoteText: We're moving away from a world where communication is siloed inside chat threads and toward a world where knowledge lives in the docs it belongs in.
